chapters.reason: The paper proposes a hierarchical generation scheme with planning tokens, which is a specialized training strategy to encourage a more structural generation of CoT steps. It involves adding embeddings to model parameters and fine-tuning, aligning with 'Training Strategies for Recurrent Reasoning'.

The method enhances reasoning through fine-tuning (full or parameter-efficient) of existing LLMs, creating implicit recurrent flows without architectural modifications, fitting 'Training-induced Recurrence' which unlocks latent reasoning capabilities.

The planning token at each step guides the model's reasoning process, suggesting a micro-level correspondence where different parts of the generation (planning vs. execution) may play distinct computational roles, akin to functional differentiation across layers.
